# Well Dweller Setup Guide

## Requirements
- Well Dweller (Steam, Windows).
- Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.
- Aurie and YYToolkit (installed with the Aurie Installer), plus the Well Dweller Archipelago mod (`WellDwellerAP.dll`).

## Installation
1. Install Aurie/YYToolkit for `Well Dweller.exe` with the [Aurie Installer.](https://github.com/AurieFramework/Aurie/releases)
2. Copy `WellDwellerAP.dll` to `<Well Dweller>\mods\aurie\`.
3. Double-click `well_dweller.apworld` (or copy it to `custom_worlds` in your Archipelago folder).

## Playing
1. Open the Archipelago Launcher and start **Well Dweller Client**. Connect to the server with your slot name.
2. If the client cannot find the game, use `/game_dir <path to the Well Dweller folder>`.
3. Start the game and begin a **new game** in an empty save slot. The mod binds that save to your slot;
   other saves are left alone and send nothing. Use a new save slot for every new seed.
4. Items arrive while you play. Checks are sent when you pick something up, beat a boss or talk to an NPC.

## Testing with Logic Test (alpha testers)
This alpha is tested with palex00's **Logic Test** world, which stops you exactly where the logic is wrong.
1. Download `logic_test.apworld` from https://github.com/palex00/Archipelago/releases/tag/logic-test-0.4.0 and
   install it like the Well Dweller apworld.
2. Put two YAMLs in Archipelago's `Players` folder: your `Well Dweller.yaml` and `Logic Test.yaml` (both come
   with the release). Only one Well Dweller slot per seed.
3. Generate and host the seed as usual.
4. Start **Well Dweller Client** (connect as your Well Dweller slot) and **Logic Test Client** (Launcher, connect
   as the Logic Test slot) and play.
5. The Logic Test holds all your items and gives them out one sphere at a time. When you have collected every
   check of the current sphere, press **Open Sphere** in the Logic Test tab (or type `/proceed`) to receive the next
   sphere's items. `/status` shows how many checks of the sphere you still need, `/keys` lists where they are.
6. Two things to report:
   - **Stuck:** a check from `/keys` that you cannot reach with the items you have. That location's logic is too
     loose.
   - **"LOGIC LEAK: KEY_n received while on sphere m"** in the Logic Test Client: you reached a check earlier than
     the logic expects. Its logic is too strict; note what you used to get there.
7. Report in the Discord with the seed and these files:
   - Archipelago `logs` folder: the latest `Launcher_*.txt` (Logic Test Client), `WellDwellerClient_*.txt` and
     `Server_*.txt`.
   - Archipelago `output` folder: the seed's `AP_<seed>.zip` (it has the spoiler).
   - `<Well Dweller>\archipelago\`: `mod.log`, `logic_breaks.txt` and `currency_log.txt`.
   Anything else (bugs, ideas) also goes in the Discord.

## Client commands
- `/game_dir [path]` - show or set the game folder.
- `/claim` - bind the loaded save to your slot (for a save that was not started fresh).
- `/wd_status` - show what the game mod reports.
- `/resync` - send every check the game has reported again.
- `/goal` - mark your goal as completed by hand.
- `/why <part of a location name>` - is the location in logic, and which single item would put it in logic.
- `/logic` - per area: how many unchecked locations are in logic.
- `/breaklog on|off` - the local sequence-break log (default on): every check you get while it is out of logic is
  written to `<Well Dweller>\archipelago\logic_breaks.txt` (time, seed name, location, items you had). It is
  never sent anywhere.

## How it works
The mod and the client talk through text files in `<Well Dweller>\archipelago\`:
`items.txt` (written by the client), `checks.txt`, `state.txt` and `mod.log` (written by the mod).
Flags the game sets that are not mapped to locations yet are listed in `unknown.txt`.

## In-game HUD and map tracker
- Bottom left: the last 5 items you sent or received (with icons) and a "Checks: found / total" counter.
- Map tracker: the mod draws a marker on the map for every location, using the game's own art (vessel, lever,
  timer = time trial, spirit, workshop token, trinket, trinket slot, page, ability egg, pearl, elevator part,
  golden feather, "!" = boss, ring = combat room, "?" = other). Bright = in logic, faded = not in logic yet,
  very faint = already checked. Move the map so a marker sits under the cursor in the middle of the screen to see
  its location name(s) and status.
  The tracker starts off: press **F6** with the map open to switch it: all items -> all uncollected -> in logic
  only -> off (remembered per save). Shop and forge checks are not on the map.
- Looter's shop trinkets are checks: buying one sends its check and gives nothing; a trinket you received from the
  multiworld stays for sale in the shop until you bought it there. The shop window shows what each check gives
  the multiworld (item, player, progression/useful/filler/trap).

## Quality of life
- The opening cutscene in the Well is skipped (option `skip_intro`): a new game starts in the Night Garden.
- The whole map is revealed when a new save starts.
- Option `tent_unlocks`: vanilla (visit a tent to add it), all_unlocked, or shuffled (each tent is an item; a tent
  you find yourself is unlocked too). With all_unlocked or shuffled the logic uses Tent Travel to the tents you have (a tent counts as
  reaching its area; the Depths also need the Water Vessel).
  Queen's Castle tents always stay vanilla.
- The Looter's shop, the trinket workshop and Ilda's map station are available in the tents from the start.
- Ability tutorial rooms are skipped: picking up an ability egg returns you to the room you found it in.
- Shop checks come into logic once the areas you can reach give enough currency for that purchase and every
  cheaper one (estimated at 1x, divided by the Currency Multiplier). The multiplier applies to all currency,
  Currency items from the multiworld included. Option `shop_prices: randomized` gives every shop entry its own
  price between `shop_price_minimum` and `shop_price_maximum` (percent of vanilla). A purchase that would need
  more currency than the whole map gives (very high prices, low multiplier) only holds filler.
- The mod writes the currency you earn in-game (at 1x, per room) to `archipelago\currency_log.txt`; F10 and
  Currency items are left out. Testers: please send this file along, it sets the shop logic estimates.
- Known issue: a gate opened by its lever item may still show its lock icon on the map.
- Currency, filler and Death Link options: currency multiplier and Currency item size, extra copies of
  Trinket Points / Workshop Tokens / Oil Vials / Golden Feathers, filler shares for Currency / boons / traps,
  Death Link Amnesty (deaths before one is sent) and Death Wish (Death Links received before one kills you).
- Option `lever_items` (experimental, Death's Door style): pulling a lever sends its check, its gate opens when
  the lever's item arrives (the room resets and puts you back where you stood if you pull a lever you don't have
  the item for). A lever opened by its item sends its own check when you first visit its room. When you don't
  start with the Matchstick, the AN_06 lever item (the gate to the lower Night Garden) is given at the start.
- Test helpers: **F10** adds 10,000 currency; **F7** writes a snapshot of menu/map values (f7_dump_N.txt) for bug reports.
- Press **F3** inside a tent to go back to the tent's exit (the shop ledges need Climb or Slingshot to leave).
  Tent Travel is unlocked from the start by default for the same reason.

# Release notes

## v0.2.0-alpha
First public release for Well Dweller as an archipelago. We are still in alpha testing which means it is stable, but will likely have remaining logic issues. Logic issues are expected to come from logic being too strict rather than too loose. Please report any logic issues you find in the [discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1553690346851143761)

### Logic
- Every area was checked room by room against the game's own geometry (spikes, gaps, bubbles) and play-tested with
  limited ability sets, so locations now ask for the abilities they really need. Over 150 locations changed.
- Desiccated Castle: most of the castle needs Soar or the Slingshot; past the AC_09 spike pit you need Soar or
  Climb with the Slingshot. AC_33 (Hover Egg) can be reached straight from the Night Garden.
- Midnight Drench: Willow's side (AL_01-AL_08) is only reached with the Drains elevator (3 Elevator Parts).
- Queen's Castle needs Climb + Wall Sling + Hover on top of the 7 Golden Feathers.
- The Depths: everything past the Torpedo's own pickup needs the Torpedo.
- The Drains: the time trial area, Wind Ride rooms and AP_28 have their own requirements.
- Dollmaker's House / Burial Vault: the stretch from AU_14 to AT_41 needs Climb + Slingshot + Hover.
- New routes the logic knows about: Hunter's Cabin -> AN_32, Midnight Drench -> AC_07/AC_08, Night Garden -> AC_33.

### Goals
- Defeating the Queen now completes the goal automatically (`/goal` stays as a fallback).

### Options
- New `time_trial_time` (100-300 %): more time for the time trials.
- `lever_items` is now described as a hard / long setting. Queen's Castle lever gates are part of its logic, the
  three levers that free Ilda's siblings always work as normal levers, and levers whose gates the logic doesn't
  use are no longer progression items.

### Game mod (0.1.9)
- Forge: each trinket's forge price goes up with every upgrade bought for it, and a trinket at its highest level
  can't be forged again.
- A Matchstick picked up from its vanilla spot (when it is shuffled) is taken away straight away instead of at the
  next save point.
- Pulling a lever without its item (lever items) puts you back once instead of dropping you onto the lever again
  and again.
- The levers that free Ilda's siblings work normally with lever items on.
- Time trial time scaling for the new option.
- **F8** records your movement to `archipelago\move_N.csv` for logic reports.

### Known issues
- The `true_ending` goal is not detected automatically yet: use `/goal` in the client.
- Shop checks come into logic later than you can actually buy them (by design, so the shop doesn't fill the
  first spheres).
v0.2.0-alpha.title: v.0.2.0 alpha

# Release notes

## v0.2.1-alpha
APWorld 0.2.1 + game mod 0.1.11. **Update both** (`well_dweller.apworld` and `WellDwellerAP.dll`) and start a new save
for a new seed. There is a new YAML template with the new goal names; YAMLs from earlier versions still work
(`true_ending` now means `completionist`, `secret_treasure` means `treasure`).

### Goals
New goal set, all detected automatically (`/goal` stays as a fallback):

| Goal | What you do |
|---|---|
| `queen` (default) | Defeat the Queen |
| `treasure` | Get all 32 trinkets and open the treasure room door (the Trinket Door in the Queen's Castle) |
| `final_flock` | Gather all 20 Spirits and the 5 Spirit Fragments, then return the fragments to the Spirit Nest |
| `completionist` | `queen` + `treasure` + `final_flock` |
| `any` | Any one of `queen`, `treasure` or `final_flock` |

Trinkets only need to be collected, not equipped.

### Checks that were not being sent
- Lida the Terrible, The Colony, The Dollmaker, Metal Doll, The Queen's Coin and Mysterious Markings were only sent
  by release/collect. They are now sent as soon as you get them.
- Rewards for an ability you already have from the multiworld are no longer lost:
  - Creature from the Deep now spawns even when you already own the Water Vessel. Beating it sends both the boss
    and the Barge (Water Vessel).
  - The Barge (Endless Climb) is sent after the Colony fight.
  - The Tent Travel egg is sent when you enter its room.

### Logic
- Blue Bow and Trinket Slot (AF_99, the wheel mini game) need the Slingshot.
- Spirit (AF_22) needs the Slingshot or Soar.
- Trinket Slot (AC_22) needs the Slingshot.
- Mysterious Markings need all 32 trinkets (they are behind the Trinket Door).

### Game mod (0.1.11)
- Creature from the Deep fix (see above). Your Water Vessel is held back only in the boss room and the room before
  it, until the boss is beaten.

### Known issues
- The game's own Spirit Nest counts the Spirit Fragments you picked up in the world, not the ones you received,
  so the ending scene can play before you have all 5 fragment items. The `final_flock` goal only completes once
  you have received them too.
- Shop checks come into logic later than you can actually buy them (by design, so the shop doesn't fill the
  first spheres).

# Release notes

## v0.2.2-alpha
APWorld 0.2.2 + game mod 0.1.12. **Update both** (`well_dweller.apworld` and `WellDwellerAP.dll`) and start a new save
for a new seed. YAMLs from v0.2.1 still work; the template only has a new description for `time_trial_checks`.

### Time trials
- `time_trial_checks` now also covers the checks next to the gate each trial opens (vessels, trinket slots, spirits,
  the Docks Postage Stamp and Pearl, ...). With the option off none of these are checks; with it on they also need
  you to be able to beat the trial.

### Logic
Many fixes from player reports. Soar alone, Endless Climb alone and the Slingshot alone were each counted in places
where they don't get you there:
- Hunter's Cabin: the race (AH_15) needs Climb; the upper part needs Climb or Soar; AH_13 token and the AH_18 checks
  from the upper tent have their own needs.
- Gravenvalley: the Witch Burning Ticket area (past AD_24) needs the Slingshot with Climb, Soar or Hover; AD_19 token
  and lever need Climb + Wall Sling/Slingshot or Soar.
- The Docks: the right side needs Climb + Hover (the AK_28/AK_30/AK_31 puzzle also the Slingshot).
- Autumn Forest from Gravenvalley: Endless Climb, Climb + Wall Sling, or Soar + Hover.
- Midnight Drench: new way in from Gravenvalley, left of Lida (after beating her; with lever items also through the
  AD_20 gate). Lady of the Drains, the AP_30 lever, and the AC_02/AC_04 checks need the Drains elevator.
- Burial Vault: only from Willow's side (Drains elevator) with Climb + Wall Sling or Soar.
- Night Garden frog spa (AN_50 token): needs the Lady of the Drains beaten and the frogs freed.
- Golden Gate Key: now also needed for the levers, vessels and slots behind the golden gates, not only the Looter Parts.
- Smaller fixes: AN_16 lever, AN_18 and AN_20 slots, Bog AB_03/AB_12/AB_22/AB_26 and the golden gate area,
  AT_22 + Golden Needle (from the Food chase), castle AC_35/AC_40, Drains AP_32/AP_33/AP_35, Dollmaker AU_07-AU_11.

### Client and map tracker
- Map markers for the Docks and Night Garden Spirit Fragments.
- The HUD no longer shows item messages from an earlier seed.

### Game mod (0.1.12)
- The shop shows the right AP item for Trinket Point, Flaming Vessel and Oil Vial (it showed the first shop trinket's
  item, or nothing after that was bought).

### Known issues
- The game's own Spirit Nest counts the Spirit Fragments you picked up in the world, not the ones you received, so
  the ending scene can play before you have all 5 fragment items. The `final_flock` goal only completes once you
  have received them too.
- Shop checks come into logic later than you can actually buy them (by design, so the shop doesn't fill the
  first spheres).
